issuer.summary: Ethereum sUSDe shares redeem into USDe under vault rules. The USDe issuer redemption path has its own eligibility and funding rules. No separate wrapper payout undertaking or direct custody claim was established.
issuer.summary_source: DeFiAnalyst exact Ethereum component documentary review, November 27, 2026. Issuer 6.5 retained.
facts: Stakers deposit USDe into the Ethereum ERC-4626 vault. Burning shares returns a proportional amount of vault USDe including distributed rewards. The holder bears underlying USDe risk and needs separate Mint User eligibility for subsequent issuer redemption. No separate corporate wrapper payout undertaking or direct claim on custodian accounts was identified.

The staking documentation describes direct contract and app access and excludes acquisition offers to persons habitually resident or registered in the EU or EEA. Vault access does not confer whitelisted USDe mint or redemption access.

On November 24 the committee supported a zero cooldown subject to continued eight-hour reward vesting and a reinstatement trigger, with exact thresholds pending. Ethereum cooldownDuration() returned 0 seconds at finalized block 26503791, November 27 03:15:23 UTC. This setting concerns the vault exit to USDe and can change.
The October 21 custodian disclosures concern underlying USDe backing. They provide no separate sUSDe financial audit, reserve priority, current share valuation or proof of funded cash exit.
The historical ENA fee-switch proposal replaced the earlier Reserve-Fund-first parameters. Its stated supply milestones are not proof of current activation.
issuer.issuer_score_basis: November17 issuer6.5 retained, bounded by USDe issuer/rights analysis. Discretionary USDe rewards and share claims do not confer primary Mint User eligibility, Reserve Fund ownership, fixed APY or separate corporate guarantee. Current beneficial-owner accountability and issuer financial audit are unverified; contract authority assessed separately.
